purpose: Authoritative register of blockers preventing closure of controlled property fixture revalidation.

blockers.description: An approved corrected or replacement controlled fixture is required before dependent revalidation can execute.
blockers.required_action: Obtain or explicitly approve a corrected/replacement fixture through the fixture governance process.

rules: Open blockers cannot be silently ignored.
A blocker may close only when its required evidence/action is recorded.
Technical blockers must remain distinct from legal-source deficiencies.
Closing a technical blocker does not establish legal correctness.
guardrails: No live official property record is claimed.
No real property fact is established.
No publication decision is made by this registry.
